educationalModelNote: All numerical models are simplified educational models, not specifications of a real robot.

missions.title: WORKSPACE & REACH
missions.concept: Reachability is defined by geometry, joint limits and collision constraints — not by visual proximity alone.
missions.scenario: A shelf target is specified by the task. You may move the joints, but you may not move the target.
missions.goalText: Match the fixed target while keeping useful joint-limit margin.
missions.transferText: Reach the new fixed target without collapsing toward the straight-arm singular posture.

missions.title: SINGULARITIES & COLLISION
missions.concept: A pose can be mathematically reachable yet be a poor operating point because motion authority collapses near a singularity or links collide.
missions.scenario: Route the wrist through a service opening. The tool size is imposed; you can change posture and body offset.
missions.goalText: Find a posture with usable motion authority, positive collision margin and enough reach.
missions.transferText: Adapt posture/body offset after the imposed tool envelope grows.

missions.title: KINEMATICS GATE
missions.concept: Demonstrate frames, joint axes, FK/IK, reachability, joint limits and collision-aware configuration selection in one integrated exercise.
missions.scenario: Commission the arm for three fixed service-rack cases.
missions.goalText: Complete the three kinematics gate cases.

gateCases.name: LIMITED IK
gateCases.text: Reach a second fixed target with the elbow on the allowed branch.

gateCases.name: COLLISION-AWARE
gateCases.text: Keep positive rack clearance and manipulability > 0.30 with a larger tool.
